declaredBefore: any candidate was fitted and before any held-out metric was computed. This file is committed on its own so the commit history proves the bars predate the results.

diagnosis.finding: Totals covered their 80% interval in 6/6 games (MAE 5.17). Margins covered in 4/6, and both misses were blowouts (19 and 20 points). The scoring prior is not the failure; MARGIN DISPERSION is.
diagnosis.target: produce matchup-dependent margin dispersion without degrading the already-calibrated scoring uncertainty

population.quarantineRule: a row missing either final score, either participant identity, or a parseable kickoff is QUARANTINED and stays in the denominator
population.excluded: the six 2026-08-13 games are a LOCKED FORWARD COHORT. They may not fit, select, or tune any candidate in this program. They remain visible in monitoring only.

splits.rule: for each target preseason season S, fit strictly on games with dateUtc earlier than the first game of S. No random splits, no shuffling, no future rows.
splits.note: 2023 preseason cannot be a target — there is no prior season in the corpus to fit on. Its absence is stated rather than silently dropped.

baselines.what: the shipped champion: one league scoring mean and one home constant, no team term
home constant alone, zero team signal
the existing cutoff-safe Elo margin slope as fitted, WITHOUT the significance gate, so the rejected model is still scored
de-vigged sportsbook consensus. EXTERNAL COMPARATOR ONLY — never a feature, never a fitting target

secondaryConstraint: team score and total quality must not materially degrade

primary.rule: marginMAE must improve on the shared_prior baseline by at least 0.50 points on the pooled held-out folds
primary.rationale: the audit's margin MAE was 9.83; half a point is the smallest improvement that is not obviously noise at this sample size

secondary.rule: marginInterval80Coverage must land in [0.72, 0.88] — the interval may not be widened into vacuous safety, and may not stay too narrow
secondary.rationale: closes INTERVAL-WIDTH-MARGIN by construction rather than by widening a constant after seeing misses

noDegradation.rule: totalMAE may not worsen by more than 0.25 points versus shared_prior, and totalInterval80Coverage may not fall below 0.72
noDegradation.rationale: totals were 6/6 in the audit; a margin fix that breaks totals is not a fix

calibration.rule: winBrier may not be worse than shared_prior, and must not be worse than the market by more than 0.010
calibration.rationale: the model has never beaten the market; the bar is that it not get further behind

invariance.rule: every direction test must pass: a stronger offense cannot lower its own scoring distribution; a stronger opposing defense cannot raise it; swapping home and away changes only documented venue effects; a larger strength gap must widen or shift the margin distribution in the expected direction
invariance.rationale: this is the test that would have caught the P178 reversed slope

prohibitions: no fitting, tuning, threshold-picking or candidate selection on the 2026-08-13 cohort
no feature observed at or after the target kickoff
no current sportsbook price as a core-model feature
no widening a constant interval after inspecting misses
no cosmetic differentiation: jitter, team-name hashing, seed churn, score nudging, market-implied score injection
no metric reported without its n
no candidate selected on its own final test result

conditions: held-out coverage leaves the declared band
a candidate cannot be reproduced byte-for-byte from its recorded inputs
rollback.action: keep BASELINE_ONLY publicly, record REJECTED_WITH_EVIDENCE, and leave the shipped champion untouched

failureIsAnOutcome: If no candidate clears these bars, the honest result is BASELINE_ONLY with a published rejection receipt. A kickoff deadline is a lock boundary, not a reason to lower a bar.
